_note: Concrete project templates. 'levels' and 'roles' list who a template suits (missing means everyone); the planner skips templates outside the user's level or role.

projects.title: Write 3 SPL detections in a home Splunk lab
projects.deliverable: GitHub repo with 3 SPL searches (brute-force logins, new admin account, suspicious PowerShell), sample logs, and a README explaining each
projects.done_when: Each search fires on a simulated attack and the README shows a screenshot of the alert

projects.title: Investigate 2 incidents end to end in Microsoft Sentinel
projects.deliverable: Two investigation write-ups (timeline, KQL queries used, verdict, recommended response) in a GitHub repo
projects.done_when: Both write-ups are published and each includes at least 3 KQL queries with their output

projects.title: Build a 5-query KQL hunting pack
projects.deliverable: Markdown file with 5 KQL hunting queries, what each finds, and the ATT&CK technique it maps to
projects.done_when: All 5 queries run without errors against a lab workspace or the Kusto Detective dataset

projects.title: Triage simulated attacks with an EDR
projects.deliverable: Write-up of 3 Atomic Red Team tests showing the EDR alert, process tree, and your triage decision
projects.done_when: 3 alerts are triaged with screenshots and a true/false-positive verdict for each

projects.title: Analyze 5 phishing emails
projects.deliverable: Report on 5 sample phishing emails: header analysis, URL/attachment verdicts, IOCs extracted
projects.done_when: Report lists sender, return-path, every URL with a verdict, and a block recommendation for each email

projects.title: Map your lab detections to MITRE ATT&CK
projects.deliverable: ATT&CK Navigator layer file plus a table linking each lab detection to its technique ID
projects.done_when: Every detection in your lab has a technique ID and the layer file is committed to GitHub

projects.title: Solve 3 packet-capture exercises
projects.deliverable: Write-ups for 3 malware-traffic-analysis.net exercises: infected host, malware family, IOCs
projects.done_when: Each write-up answers every question in the exercise and lists the Wireshark filters used

projects.title: Write a PowerShell log-collection script
projects.deliverable: PowerShell script on GitHub that pulls failed-logon events (4625) from the last 24h and exports CSV
projects.done_when: Script runs on a Windows VM and produces a CSV; README shows sample output

projects.title: Build a Python IOC extractor
projects.deliverable: Python script that extracts IPs, domains, and hashes from a text file and checks them against a blocklist
projects.done_when: Script has a README, handles 3 sample inputs, and includes at least 3 unit tests

projects.title: Write a HIPAA-aware incident report
projects.deliverable: Sample incident report for a phishing-led PHI exposure: timeline, scope, HIPAA breach assessment, lessons learned
projects.done_when: Report covers all four HIPAA breach risk-assessment factors and is under 3 pages

projects.title: Stand up a home SOC lab
projects.deliverable: Lab with a Windows VM, a Linux VM and Security Onion or Splunk, documented with a network diagram
projects.done_when: Logs from both VMs are visible in the SIEM and the diagram is in the repo

projects.title: Build a Windows Server Active Directory lab
projects.deliverable: Lab with a domain controller, 2 OUs, 10 users, 3 security groups and 2 Group Policies (password policy, drive mapping), documented in a GitHub README with screenshots
projects.done_when: A Windows 10/11 VM joins the domain and both GPOs apply (gpresult screenshot in the README)

projects.title: Script bulk user onboarding with PowerShell
projects.deliverable: PowerShell script on GitHub that creates AD users from a CSV, adds them to groups, and writes a log; plus an offboarding script that disables and moves accounts
projects.done_when: Running both scripts against the lab creates and then disables 10 test users with no errors, shown in the README

projects.title: Run a mock help desk in ServiceNow
projects.deliverable: Free ServiceNow instance with 15 resolved sample tickets (password reset, printer, VPN, new hire) and 5 knowledge-base articles you wrote
projects.done_when: Each ticket has a category, priority, resolution notes and links to a KB article; screenshots in a portfolio page

projects.title: Enroll and manage a device with Intune
projects.deliverable: Write-up showing one Windows VM enrolled in Intune with a compliance policy, a configuration profile and one deployed app
projects.done_when: The device shows as compliant in the Intune console, with screenshots of each policy in the write-up

projects.title: Design and document a segmented home network
projects.deliverable: Network diagram plus config notes for 3 VLANs (trusted, IoT, guest) with a subnet plan, DHCP scopes and firewall rules, in a GitHub repo
projects.done_when: A device on the guest VLAN can reach the internet but not the trusted VLAN, proven with ping/traceroute output in the repo

projects.title: Set up and harden a Linux server
projects.deliverable: Ubuntu server VM with key-only SSH, a non-root sudo user, UFW firewall, unattended upgrades and a cron backup script, documented step by step
projects.done_when: Password SSH login is refused, the backup cron job has run at least twice, and the README lists every command used

projects.title: Build and deploy a full-stack app
projects.deliverable: Deployed web app (React front end, REST API, database) with login and full CRUD for one resource, a public URL, and a README with setup steps and screenshots
projects.done_when: A stranger can sign up, create, edit and delete a record on the live URL, and the repo has at least 10 meaningful commits

projects.title: Build a tested REST API
projects.deliverable: REST API with 5+ endpoints, input validation, a SQL database, and an OpenAPI/README describing each endpoint
projects.done_when: All endpoints have automated tests that pass in CI, and the README shows example requests and responses

projects.title: Add tests and CI to an existing project
projects.deliverable: One of your existing repos with 20+ unit tests and a GitHub Actions workflow that runs them on every pull request, with a status badge in the README
projects.done_when: The badge is green on main and a PR that breaks a test shows a red check

projects.title: Containerize an app with Docker Compose
projects.deliverable: Dockerfile plus docker-compose.yml that runs your app and its database with one command, documented in the README
projects.done_when: A fresh clone runs with `docker compose up` and the app responds on localhost with no other setup

projects.title: Solve a structured set of coding problems
projects.deliverable: GitHub repo with solutions to 75 NeetCode problems, each with time/space complexity and a one-line note on the pattern used
projects.done_when: 75 problems are committed across at least 8 pattern categories, and you can solve 3 random mediums in 45 minutes each

projects.title: Get a pull request merged into an open-source project
projects.deliverable: A merged pull request in a public repo with 100+ stars, linked from your resume and GitHub profile
projects.done_when: The PR shows as merged by a maintainer and is listed under Projects or Experience on your resume

projects.title: Answer real questions with SQL
projects.deliverable: Repo with a public dataset loaded into PostgreSQL and 10 SQL queries (joins, GROUP BY, window functions) that answer stated questions, with results
projects.done_when: All 10 queries run from a single script and the README shows each question, query and output table

projects.title: Deploy an app to AWS
projects.deliverable: An app of yours running on AWS (e.g. EC2 or Elastic Beanstalk with RDS), with an architecture diagram and a teardown/cost note in the README
projects.done_when: The app is reachable on a public URL and the README lists every AWS service used and its monthly cost

projects.title: Write a system design doc for one of your projects
projects.deliverable: 2-4 page design doc for scaling one of your apps to 100k users: requirements, diagram, data model, bottlenecks and trade-offs
projects.done_when: The doc covers caching, database choice and failure handling, and a mid/senior engineer has reviewed it

projects.title: Use a team Git workflow on a real project
projects.deliverable: Project repo where every change went through a feature branch and pull request with a description, including one resolved merge conflict
projects.done_when: At least 8 merged PRs with descriptions, and the README explains the branching workflow

projects.title: Ship one small portfolio project end to end
projects.deliverable: Public GitHub repo for a small app or tool you designed yourself, with a README covering the problem, how to run it, and screenshots or a demo GIF
projects.done_when: A classmate can clone and run it from the README alone, and it is listed under Projects on your resume with one quantified bullet

projects.title: Build and demo a project at a hackathon
projects.deliverable: Hackathon submission with a public repo, a 2-minute demo video, and a note on what you built versus your teammates
projects.done_when: The project is submitted and demoed before judging closes, and it is on your resume with your specific contribution

projects.title: Mentor a junior teammate through code reviews
projects.deliverable: A written review guide for your team plus 10 substantive reviews on a less experienced engineer's pull requests
projects.done_when: Your manager or the mentee confirms the reviews helped, and one resume bullet describes the outcome with a number

projects.title: Provision a small cloud stack with Terraform
projects.deliverable: Repo with Terraform that creates a network, a compute instance and a database, with remote state and a README showing plan and apply output
projects.done_when: terraform apply builds the stack from scratch, terraform destroy removes it cleanly, and CI runs terraform validate

projects.title: Add monitoring and alerting to a running service
projects.deliverable: Dashboard with latency, error rate and traffic for one of your services, two alert rules, and a one-page runbook for each alert
projects.done_when: Each alert fires when you inject the failure it watches for, and the runbook steps resolve it

projects.title: Train, evaluate and write up a model on a public dataset
projects.deliverable: Notebook and repo that train two models on a public dataset, compare them against a simple baseline, and explain the metric choice in the README
projects.done_when: The README reports the test-set score against the baseline, and someone else can rerun the notebook from a clean environment

projects.title: Fine-tune a pretrained model and publish it
projects.deliverable: A pretrained model fine-tuned on a public dataset, published on the Hugging Face Hub with a model card covering data, metrics and limitations
projects.done_when: The fine-tuned model beats the base model on a held-out set and the model card shows both scores

projects.title: Build a retrieval-augmented LLM app with an eval set
projects.deliverable: App that answers questions over a document set using retrieval plus an LLM, with a 25-question evaluation set and a script that scores it
projects.done_when: The eval script runs in one command, and the README reports accuracy before and after one improvement you made

projects.title: Serve a model behind an API with tracking and monitoring
projects.deliverable: Containerized API serving a trained model, with experiment runs logged in MLflow and a drift or latency dashboard
projects.done_when: A request to the API returns a prediction, retraining is one command, and the dashboard shows live metrics

projects.title: Analyze a public dataset and publish the findings
projects.deliverable: Notebook and one-page write-up answering three specific questions about a public dataset, with cleaned data, charts and stated caveats
projects.done_when: Each question has a chart and a one-sentence answer, and the notebook runs top to bottom without errors

projects.title: Build a public dashboard that answers a business question
projects.deliverable: Published dashboard on a public dataset with 3-5 views, filters, and a short note on the decision it supports
projects.done_when: The dashboard is public, loads in under 10 seconds, and a non-technical friend can answer the question using it

projects.title: Fit and interpret a regression model
projects.deliverable: Notebook fitting a regression on a public dataset with diagnostics, coefficient interpretation in plain language, and limitations
projects.done_when: Assumptions are checked with plots, and every coefficient you report has a confidence interval and a one-line meaning

projects.title: Analyze an A/B test end to end
projects.deliverable: Analysis of a public A/B test dataset: hypothesis, sample size and power check, result with confidence interval, and a ship or don't-ship recommendation
projects.done_when: The write-up states the minimum detectable effect, checks for sample ratio mismatch, and ends with a clear recommendation

projects.title: Find and fix vulnerabilities in an intentionally vulnerable app
projects.deliverable: Write-ups for 5 vulnerabilities you exploited in a deliberately vulnerable app (such as OWASP Juice Shop), each with the fix as a code diff
projects.done_when: Each write-up shows the exploit request, the root cause and a patch that stops the exploit when you retest

projects.title: Root 5 practice machines and write up each one
projects.deliverable: Five public write-ups of retired practice machines covering enumeration, exploitation, privilege escalation and the fix
projects.done_when: All five boxes are rooted, and each write-up lists the remediation a defender should apply

projects.title: Write a threat model for an open-source app
projects.deliverable: Threat model with a data-flow diagram, trust boundaries, STRIDE threats ranked by risk, and mitigations for the top five
projects.done_when: The maintainers or a security engineer review it, and at least one mitigation is filed as an issue

projects.title: Add security scanning to a CI pipeline
projects.deliverable: CI pipeline on one of your repos running SAST and dependency scanning, with one custom rule and a triage note for each finding
projects.done_when: The pipeline fails on a planted vulnerability and passes once it is fixed

projects.title: Audit and harden a cloud account
projects.deliverable: Audit report for a sandbox cloud account: misconfigurations found, least-privilege IAM fixes, logging enabled, and before/after evidence
projects.done_when: Every finding has a fix applied and verified, and cloud audit logging is on

projects.title: Write a sensor driver for a microcontroller
projects.deliverable: Repo with a C driver for a sensor over I2C or SPI on a microcontroller board, a wiring diagram and a demo video
projects.done_when: The board prints correct sensor readings, the driver has no busy-wait delays in its main loop, and the README explains the register setup

projects.title: Build a multi-task firmware project on an RTOS
projects.deliverable: Firmware with at least three RTOS tasks, a queue between them and a timing diagram showing that deadlines are met
projects.done_when: A logic analyzer or trace capture confirms each task meets its deadline under load

projects.title: Build a computer from logic gates
projects.deliverable: Completed Nand to Tetris hardware projects 1-5 (gates through a working CPU) in a public repo with notes on each design
projects.done_when: All projects pass the course test scripts, and the CPU runs the provided test programs

projects.title: Write a small systems program in C
projects.deliverable: A C program such as a shell, an allocator or a key-value store, with a Makefile, tests and a clean Valgrind run
projects.done_when: Tests pass, and Valgrind reports no leaks or invalid reads

projects.title: Design, order and bring up a small PCB
projects.deliverable: Two-layer board designed in KiCad (schematic, layout, BOM), fabricated, assembled and tested, documented in a repo
projects.done_when: The assembled board powers up and passes your written test checklist, and the repo has the Gerbers and a bring-up log

projects.title: Implement and verify a design on an FPGA
projects.deliverable: RTL for a UART, VGA or similar module with a testbench and waveforms, running on a low-cost FPGA board
projects.done_when: The testbench passes in simulation and the design works on real hardware, shown in a demo video

projects.title: Simulate, build and measure an analog circuit
projects.deliverable: Filter or amplifier circuit with hand calculations, an LTspice simulation and bench measurements compared in one report
projects.done_when: Measured gain and cutoff are within 10% of the simulation, or the report explains the difference

projects.title: Debug a board with an oscilloscope and logic analyzer
projects.deliverable: Lab notebook entry for diagnosing a real fault: probe points, captured waveforms, root cause and fix
projects.done_when: The fault is fixed and the notebook has the before and after captures

projects.title: Write a self-checking testbench
projects.deliverable: Self-checking SystemVerilog testbench with constrained-random stimulus and functional coverage for one of your RTL modules
projects.done_when: The testbench catches a bug you inject on purpose and reports at least 90% functional coverage

projects.title: Write an end-to-end test suite for a web app
projects.deliverable: Repo with 15 end-to-end tests for a public demo web app using the page-object pattern, running headless in CI
projects.done_when: The suite passes in CI on three runs in a row with no flaky failures, and the README explains how to add a test

projects.title: Build an API test collection that runs in CI
projects.deliverable: API test collection covering happy paths, validation errors and auth for a public API, run from the command line in CI
projects.done_when: The collection runs in CI with a report, and it fails when you point it at a deliberately broken endpoint

projects.title: Write a test plan and file bug reports for a real app
projects.deliverable: Test plan for one feature of an open-source app, 20 test cases, and 3 bug reports filed with steps, expected and actual results
projects.done_when: At least one bug report is confirmed by the maintainers, and the test plan lists scope, risks and exit criteria

projects.title: Load-test a service and report its limits
projects.deliverable: Load test scripts for one of your services with a report showing throughput, p95 latency and the breaking point
projects.done_when: The report names the bottleneck you found and shows a rerun after one fix

projects.title: Write a PRD for a feature in a product you use
projects.deliverable: Two-page PRD covering problem, target users, success metrics, scope and non-goals, with a rough wireframe
projects.done_when: A working PM or engineer reviews it, and you revise it based on their comments

projects.title: Run 5 user interviews and synthesize the findings
projects.deliverable: Interview guide, notes from 5 interviews, and a one-page synthesis of the top problems with supporting quotes
projects.done_when: All 5 interviews are done with real target users, and the synthesis ends with one recommended next step

projects.title: Define success metrics and a dashboard for a product
projects.deliverable: Metrics plan for a real product: north-star metric, input metrics, a funnel, guardrail metrics, and a mock dashboard
projects.done_when: Each metric has a definition precise enough to write as SQL, and the dashboard mock shows the funnel

projects.title: Prototype a feature in Figma and test it with users
projects.deliverable: Clickable Figma prototype of one feature plus notes from 3 usability tests and the changes you made
projects.done_when: Three people complete the main task in the prototype, and version 2 fixes the top issue they hit

projects.title: Run a prioritization review for a real backlog
projects.deliverable: Scored backlog of 15+ items using RICE or a similar framework, a quarter roadmap, and a decision memo for stakeholders
projects.done_when: Stakeholders sign off on the memo, or you record their objections and the changes you made

projects.title: Practice product interview cases with written answers
projects.deliverable: Written answers to 10 product design and metrics questions, each following one framework, reviewed by a peer
projects.done_when: A peer or mentor scores each answer, and you redo the three weakest ones

projects.title: Scan a lab network and write a remediation report
projects.deliverable: Report from scanning your own lab network: hosts and services found, the top 5 vulnerabilities ranked by risk, and a fix for each
projects.done_when: You fix at least two findings, rescan, and the report shows the before and after results
